'''Shaft 12''' was a mining shaft on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], established by the miners of the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]] around [[3631 BBY]]. After the miners accidentally desecrated the burial cite of [[Xivhkalrainik's father]], his son, Sith Lord [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]] began attacking their mining camps, slaughtering everyone and leaving no survivors. Shaft 12 was one of his targets, where everyone present there at the time of the attack perished.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shaft 12 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during Xalek Alliance alert mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
